summary: Each book's fine is "5 pesos per late day, never below 0, never above 50". We compute it per book with `max` for the floor and `min` for the cap, then add them up (T7 — clamping).

blocks.title: Read the books
blocks.text: N on the first line, then all the day counts on one line, split and converted to `int`.

blocks.title: Go through each book
blocks.text: `total` collects the fines. We loop over the day counts directly — we do not need the index.

blocks.title: Late days, never negative
blocks.text: `d - 7` is the number of days beyond the 7th. For a book returned early, `d - 7` is negative, and `max(0, …)` turns that into 0 — otherwise an early book would *lower* the total.

blocks.title: Cap each book at 50
blocks.text: `min(fine, 50)` applies the cap to **this book**, not to the total. Capping the total instead is a classic mistake.

blocks.title: Add to the total
blocks.text: The book's clamped fine joins the running total.

pitfalls: Capping the total instead of each book.
